should_trigger: review this Pulumi preview before I run pulumi up
renaming this ComponentResource replaces all its children — help review it
check our Pulumi program for plaintext secrets in state
is deleteBeforeReplace safe for this production database

should_not_trigger: review this terraform plan before apply
check this CloudFormation change set for replacements
write a Python script that calls an unrelated REST API

tasks.prompt: A refactor renames a production database resource and moves it under a new ComponentResource. Preview shows one delete and one create. Review the change.
criteria: treats the database replacement as blocking until identity is preserved or migration is planned
recommends aliases that account for name and parent-path changes
requires a new preview for every affected stack
does not assume the matching physical cloud name prevents replacement

tasks.prompt: A TypeScript Pulumi program reads a password with config.require, interpolates it into a command, exports it, and logs the resulting Output inside apply. Review it.
criteria: identifies that require does not mark configuration as secret and recommends requireSecret or equivalent
traces exposure through command inputs, exports, logs, and state
explains that secret propagation does not make explicit logging safe
gives a concrete remediation and verification plan without requesting the secret

tasks.prompt: Team uses a local Pulumi backend for a shared production stack, has frequent console edits, and runs pulumi up without refresh from two CI jobs.
criteria: flags backend locking, concurrency, history, backup, and access-control risk
explains recorded state versus out-of-band cloud drift
proposes serialized updates and an explicit reviewed refresh decision
